# Zurich Graphics
> India's leading real estate branding agency, offering end-to-end marketing solutions — from brand strategy and creative design to digital campaigns, outdoor advertising, and exhibitions. Based in Vadodara, Gujarat, serving clients across India for over 31 years. Trusted by 10,000+ clients across real estate, architecture, and premium businesses.
